resources.string: Go to Home or Search to find an event. Use the filter button to narrow your results by date or tags.
To view an event’s details or to join its waitlist, tap the event.
After opening an event, you can press Join Waitlist. This adds you to the event’s waitlist, where you will have a chance to be chosen for the event through the lottery.
The Registration Limit indicates how many people may be chosen through the lottery.
After joining the waitlist, wait until the registration deadline to see if you’re chosen for the event.
Once the registration deadline passes, the lottery is drawn automatically. Entrants in the waitlist are randomly chosen to participate in the event.
If you were chosen, you will be notified in the app upon logging in.
You can check the notification bell in Home to view your past notifications.
You can also view your status for the event under My Events, where you will see a Chosen indicator if you were chosen for the event.
If you weren’t chosen, you will stay on the waitlist and may still be chosen if a chosen participant unregisters from the event.
If you were chosen, open the event in My Events and press Register to secure your spot.
Check the event’s time and location, and watch for notifications sent by the organizer through the app.
